notes: Implementation regressions used at most 1000 popped nodes. Subsequent complete exploratory passes are recorded separately in census-shallow-summary.json, census-deep-summary.json, and census-tail-summary.json.
--max-nodes and --gas are required; 0<=gas<=8192; default root all; default rungs none.
--rungs allows at most eight n:t pairs with 1<=n<=8 and 0<=t<=gas.
All-root scope explicitly records the empty-root None branch; single-root scope covers only the selected normalized subtree.
Every H pop records a halt completion family whose reached slot remains undefined, then expands all allowed defined children including the last hole.
halted_actual_completions counts unweighted terminal families, not all labelled table completions.
Cycle hash candidates and C translated-window candidates require exact Coq replay; side and excursion width are short exact-simulation metadata only.
Tail-only finite ngram candidates retain n,t,context count and a conservative contexts+1 candidate wait bound; supplied ranks/closure or search must still pass Ranked.v.
candidate_wait_upper is conditional on cutoff B>=anchor and is not a checked certificate.
Residual TSV contains unknown and pending families; all candidate ledger rows also await proof replay and receive zero current proof credit.
Frontier TSV retains the exact DFS pop order and unused-state ptr; it is saved data, not a verified resumable proof.
Legacy holdout lookup and all coarse QH-only pruning are disabled.
Byte-identical repeated pilots, accounting identities, full-machine presence, and last-hole expansion are tested.
Large-rung runtime is not bounded by max-nodes alone; measure runtime before increasing the node cap.

pilot.candidate_bound_condition: cutoff B >= anchor; exact Coq replay still required
pilot.family_semantics: unknown and pending rows represent all completions, with TNF ptr retained
pilot.halt_family_semantics: reached halt_slot must remain undefined; other undefined slots arbitrary

tail_ngram_change.behavioral_change: Require q-avoiding-subgraph acyclicity only for states appearing in the final closed tail; do not require prefix-only states to recur.

coq_regression.command: PATH=/workspace/.opam/census/bin:$PATH coqc -Q theories BBB4 -Q wait42/theories BBBWait42 wait42/build/TailNGramRegression.v
coq_regression.source:
From Coq Require Import Arith Lia.
From BBB4 Require Import BBB4_Statement.
From BBBWait42 Require Import Spec Ranked.
Definition prefix_tail : TM := fun q s =>
 match q, s with
 | StA, S0 => Some (mkTrans S1 DR StB)
 | StB, S0 => Some (mkTrans S0 DR StB)
 | _, _ => None
 end.
Example disappeared_prefix_checked :
 ngram_ranked_search prefix_tail 1 1 64 4 16 = true.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.
Example appearing_avoidance_cycle_rejected :
 ngram_ranked_search prefix_tail 1 0 64 4 16 = false.
Proof. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.
Theorem disappeared_prefix_window : forall B, 1 <= B -> WindowBound prefix_tail B 16.
Proof.
 intros B HB. apply (ngram_ranked_search_sound prefix_tail 1 1 64 4 16 B);
 [exact HB|exact disappeared_prefix_checked].
Qed.
Print Assumptions disappeared_prefix_window.

anchor_0.reason: A appears in the anchor-0 closure, but B has a cycle avoiding A.

tail_ngram_change.trust: Untrusted C candidate gate; all positive rows require exact Coq replay.
tail_ngram_change.unchanged: Seed construction, donation-gated growth, closedness rebuild, and Kahn peeling.

trust: untrusted bounded candidate survey; zero kernel or universal coverage credit
